senses.gloss: f. (חלל, cmp. חֵילַת I) a loose wicker-work used for making bee-hives, strainers, for wine presses, screens &c.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:5">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>תותי ח׳</he> behind a screen (Rashi: bee-hive; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 148:1">Yalk. Sam. 148</cite> <cite ref="K00557"><he>כילתא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 148:1">Ib.</cite> <he>פתקה לח׳</he> it (the arrow) made an opening in the screen.
Sabb. 35ᵃ ח׳ בת תרי כורי a basket containing two khor.

<cite ref="Shabbat 74b:5">Ib. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דעבד ח׳</he> he who makes a wicker-work on the Sabbath (going through the whole process of cutting reeds &c.).—Pl. <he>חַלָּאתָא</he>, <cite ref="H01130"><he>חַלָּתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>חלתא דיקולי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דקולי וחלא׳</he>, Ar. incorr. <he>ח׳ דדיק׳</he>) the palm or reed strainers which are twined with ropes of palm-rind.
